limitations: Text detector evaluation, not end-to-end agent attack success or utility.
NotInject contains only benign examples; InjecAgent contains only attacks.
Pooled precision is dependent on the artificial source/class mix, not deployment prevalence.
Cases share templates/families; row-level Wilson intervals are descriptive and may be too narrow.
Public datasets may have appeared in model training; independence is not established.
NotInject trigger components form only two groups (246 dev / 93 holdout); this strict leakage safeguard creates a domain shift and a very small effective sample.
